governance_note: SR0-2: no independent holdout evidence exists for the current version. Research, shadow and sandbox runs are allowed; real-money routing is refused by core.strategy_governance.assert_live_admission.

expected_diagnosis.cause: cross-symbol close events counted as independent health observations; is_alive had no expiry

data_partition.rule: The final holdout is opened once. Parameters may never be selected or re-selected on it; a failed gate requires a new hypothesis and a new protocol entry.

admission_gates.G-S1_lifecycle: no silent inactivity; health/stop state reconstructable
admission_gates.G-S2_positive_oos_edge: strategy and risk-adjusted excess return both positive
admission_gates.G-S3_pf_significance: cohort-level PF above threshold with CI lower bound > 1
admission_gates.G-S4_drawdown: within the pre-registered maximum, acceptable recovery time
admission_gates.G-S5_concentration: net profit still positive after removing the top 5/10 cohorts
admission_gates.G-S6_cost_stress: 1.5x must pass; 2x must not reverse catastrophically
admission_gates.G-S7_parameter_plateau: neighbours of the optimum mostly pass
admission_gates.G-S8_cross_market: >=2 data sources/timeframes and multiple regimes agree in direction
admission_gates.G-S9_execution_risk: actual risk, stop lifecycle and financing all reconcile
admission_gates.G-S10_multiple_testing: deflated Sharpe / registered trial count meets the pre-registered bar

status.SR0: SR0-2 and SR0-3 done; SR0-1 open - the 30-symbol baseline has not been re-run three times against this code, and the expected diagnosis above is a registered expectation, not a verified artifact
status.SR2: SR2-1..SR2-5 done (protective-order lifecycle implemented and wired into the live tick); the backtest matcher still lacks venue-resident intrabar stop equivalence (STR-P1-01)
status.SR3: SR3-1..SR3-4 done (ranking, correlation budgets, control attribution, account cost contract); stress scenarios and correlation-estimated clusters ride along with SR4
status.SR5: blocked on SR3/SR4; the final holdout must stay closed
